run_bench_gpu_1bn: run a GPU benchmark on SIFT1M or Deep1B datasets with IVFPQ index and configurable nprobe values
run_bench_gpu_1bn_knngraph: run the GPU benchmark in k-nn graph mode to compute nearest neighbor graphs with intersection measure evaluation
run_bench_gpu_1bn_multigpu: run the GPU benchmark across multiple GPUs with sharded index and replica count options
review_mmap_fvecs: review the mmap_fvecs function that memory-maps fvecs binary files into numpy float32 arrays
review_mmap_bvecs: review the mmap_bvecs function that memory-maps bvecs binary files into numpy float32 arrays
review_dataset_iterator: review the dataset_iterator function that iterates over vector blocks with a preprocessor applied
review_eval_intersection_measure: review the eval_intersection_measure function that computes ranklist intersection size between ground truth and results
review_train_preprocessor: review the train_preprocessor function that trains OPQ or PCA vector transforms on the dataset
review_train_coarse_quantizer: review the train_coarse_quantizer function that trains IVF centroids using GPU-accelerated k-means clustering
review_compute_populated_index: review the compute_populated_index function that adds vectors to a sharded GPU index in batches
review_compute_populated_index_2: review the compute_populated_index_2 function that uses a 3-stage pipeline for alternative index population
review_get_populated_index: review the get_populated_index function that loads or builds an index and moves it to GPU with optional replicas
review_eval_dataset: review the eval_dataset function that performs batched GPU search and reports recall metrics at various ranks
review_compute_GT: review the compute_GT function that computes ground truth nearest neighbors using a flat L2 index on GPU
review_identpreproc_class: review the IdentPreproc class that acts as a no-op vector transform with matching input and output dimensions
